narrative.overview:
One world owns the page: a surveyor's triangulation sheet. Devices are observation stations plotting writes onto cool ink drafting paper; the cobalt net converges them into one resolved point. The ground is ink paper ruled at a 36px pitch by a repeating hairline — this ruling is the sheet's material, not decoration. Structure is carried by 1px hairlines, never by fills, blocks, or heavy borders. Cobalt is the surveyor's plotting ink: the only saturated color on the sheet, spent on the single primary action, convergence lines, and kept-state marks.

The density is documentation-grade: SQL traces, merged-row tables, convergence matrices, and mono measurement captions do the persuading; prose stays measured and short-measure. Every figure ships with a provenance caption, and the footer signs the sheet ('Sheet 001 — set in Inter · plotted in cobalt').
keyCharacteristics: Cool ink drafting-paper ground: a ten-step low-saturation ink ramp, ruled at 36px, with white cards laid on it like plot sheets.
One saturated ink: cobalt for plotting — primary CTA, convergence lines, kept marks, focus ring, selection.
Hairline architecture: 1px rules in ink-2/ink-3 separate sections, tiers, table cells, and footer columns.
States are drawn marks, never hue swaps: cobalt plus-mark (kept), ink cross (superseded), dashed outline (pending).
Inter for every heading, body, and label; mono only where a machine wrote the line (code, SQL, traces, hashes, measurements).
Documentation-grade artifacts: every table, trace, and figure carries a mono measurement caption in muted ink.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only saturated color permitted on the sheet. Every other value comes from the ink ramp or white; introducing a second hue is a world break, not a palette extension.

rules.name: The Ruled Ground Rule
rules.body: The page ground is Survey Paper ruled at a 36px pitch by a 1px repeating hairline of deepest ink at 0.028 alpha. The ruling is the world's material: it stays on every surface that reads as 'the sheet', and any tinted overlay must derive from a token (alpha overlays use ink-9's RGB).

rules.name: The Mark-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: State is drawn, never recolored: kept = cobalt plus-mark, superseded = ink cross, pending = dashed ink-3 outline, featured = 1.5px cobalt inset outline. No state is ever signaled by swapping a fill or text hue.

rules.name: The Pinned Face Rule
rules.body: Inter is the house face, pinned by the brand brief. Headings, body, labels, chart annotations, prices — all Inter. No other face is introduced for any role; display or label 'variety' comes from weight (400–800) and tracking, not from a second family.

rules.name: The Mono Scope Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only where a machine wrote the line: code, SQL, traces, hashes, timestamps, and measurement values. It never sets prose, headings, navigation, or labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that could be compared down a column is tabular: code, traces, measurements, chart labels, and prices all set "tnum" / tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Section vertical padding is clamp(80px, 9vw, 120px) — at desktop width it must resolve within 80–128px. Sections are separated by the Hairline rule, not by extra padding.

rules.name: The Persistent Sheet Rule
rules.body: The sticky hairline top nav is present at load and on scroll and always carries the wordmark plus the single primary CTA ('Install the extension'), rendered as the same button component everywhere it appears. One primary action per surface; at most one secondary (a text link).

rules.name: The Subordinate Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hairlines structure; shadows merely rest. A shadow may appear only under a raised paper panel or the primary button, always low-alpha and always derived from a token's RGB. Elevation never substitutes for a rule, a mark, or a state change.

dos: Do draw state as marks: kept = cobalt plus-mark, superseded = ink cross, pending = dashed ink-3 outline, featured = 1.5px cobalt inset outline.
Do caption every trace, table, and figure with a mono measurement line (0.76rem, 0.03em, Measurement Ink).
Do separate sections, tiers, and table cells with 1px hairlines (ink-2 standard, ink-3 load-bearing).
Do set all comparable numerals tabular ("tnum"): code, traces, measurements, chart labels, prices.
Do keep the sticky hairline nav and its single primary CTA on every surface, and end documents on the deep-ink footer band signing the sheet.
Do derive any alpha overlay (ruling, shadow, tint) from a token's own RGB — deepest ink for ink washes.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated hue; cobalt is the only one, and Cobalt Deep/Cobalt-on-Dark are its only companions.
Don't signal state with hue or fill swaps — that is the one move this world forbids.
Don't set any heading, label, or prose in a face other than Inter, or use mono outside code, SQL, traces, hashes, and measurements.
Don't use pill badges, kicker/eyebrow labels, gradient text, glass/blur, floating gradient blobs, all-centered stacks, hard offset shadows, or decorative section numbers.
Don't remove, blur, or restyle the 36px ruled drafting ground — it is the sheet's material, not a background choice.
Don't add a second primary button or a shadow that structures; the single cobalt CTA and the hairline carry the page.
